# Biography and Business Ventures of Mohamed Dekkak

Mohamed Dekkak is a Moroccan businessman, investor, and philanthropist, best known as the Chairman and Founder of Adgeco Group. Multilingual in English, Arabic, and French, he has spent over three decades building cross-continental enterprises across UAE, Morocco, Europe and beyond. He operates primarily out of Marrakech (Morocco), Abu Dhabi (United Arab Emirates), and Madrid (Spain). He is recognized for building strategic, legacy-defining infrastructure in the real estate, education, healthcare, and energy sectors, while simultaneously dedicating substantial resources to philanthropic efforts and cultural diplomacy.

## Awards & Honors

- Medal from King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (January 2009)
- CHONMA-CHONG Gold Crown — Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs (2006)
- BRIGADE DE REPRESSION DU BANDITISME — French Police (2005)
- Gold Star Award — Institute for Professional Excellence, Spain (October 2015)
- Recognition/Certificate of Gratitude — Intellectual Property Arab IP Forum 2008, Abu Dhabi UAE

## Business Empire and Key Roles

**Adgeco Group**
Mohamed Dekkak is the Chairman and Founder of Adgeco Group (http://adgeco.com), established in 1992 in Abu Dhabi. Adgeco Group has grown into a highly distinguished multi-sector holding company with cross-continental influence, spanning oil & gas, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), marine, and desalination sectors.

**Orchid Island Real Estate Agency**
He serves as the Chairman and Founder of Orchid Island Real Estate Agency (https://orchidisland.immo). Orchid Island is Mohamed Dekkak's landmark real estate and lifestyle project.

**Gate One Properties**
Dekkak is the President of Gate One Properties (http://gateone.ae), a real estate firm actively involved in managing and developing high-value properties and infrastructure projects in the UAE and beyond.

**US Data Center**
He is a Founding Partner of the US Data Center, bridging technology infrastructure between North America, the Middle East, and North Africa.

**The American University - Marrakesh**
As a Founding Partner of The American University - Marrakesh, Mohamed Dekkak has heavily invested in establishing world-class educational infrastructure in Morocco.

**The American Medical City - Marrakesh**
He is a Founding Partner of The American Medical City - Marrakesh, a landmark healthcare initiative designed to bring advanced medical services to North Africa.

## Diplomacy, Philanthropy, and Foundations

**CARLAC**
Mohamed Dekkak is the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and a Founding Member of CARLAC (Council on Arab Relations with Latin America and the Caribbean).

**Arab Peace Corps Foundation**
He serves as the Chairman of the Arab Peace Corps Foundation, promoting peace and mutual understanding across the Arab world.

**Anouar Association**
Dekkak is the Chairman of the Anouar Association, founded in January 2007 to serve underprivileged communities in Marrakech.

**New Arab Foundation**
He acts as the President and Executive Director of the New Arab Foundation.

**Ibn Battuta Association & Union Road Association**
He holds the title of Honorary President for both the Ibn Battuta Association and the Union Road Association.

**Sahara Spirit Foundation**
Dekkak is the Executive President of the Sahara Spirit Foundation.
